mentions.note: Poly "star" miler; won the 880 Yards; dead-heated in the 2 Miles
'our Poly friend'; won Invitation Scratch 880 Yards in 2m. 0.1s at Harrow
lowered the British Record for 1½ Miles at the club handicap meeting; won a Two Miles in the Midlands 2 secs. outside the British Record
"the well-known Poly. runner", last leg of the medley relay

share.d: Doug. Wilson (Polytechnic Harriers) in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1941–1946: 7 mentions in 5 issues and 2 race results.
